placers.name: Coleman Lee
placers.note: GHSA 1A 144, 2025. Georgia awarded TWO sixth places at this weight and no fifth: Coleman Lee took a medical forfeit and Hogan Sims was disqualified, both marked as such in the brackets ('MFF-' and 'DQ-' name prefixes), so the fifth-place match was never wrestled. The state published the tie, but state_tournament_placers carries a unique index over (season, state, association, gender, classification, weight, place) and cannot store two wrestlers at one place. Both men's placements are blanked rather than one of them arbitrarily keeping sixth; their entries, schools and 2-2 records are on file. Restore both to 6th if the index is ever relaxed (24 Oct 2026).

placers.name: Hogan Sims
placers.note: GHSA 1A 144, 2025 — the other half of the tie described under Coleman Lee. Disqualified in the consolation round; Georgia still listed him sixth. Placement blanked for the same index reason, not because the result is doubted (24 Oct 2026).

preFreshmanVerified.note: Mike Dodd, Stratford Academy, class of 2028. Placed at the 2024 GIAA championship before his freshman year, which Georgia's private association allows and its public one does not: GHSA By-Law 1.45 makes eighth graders never varsity-eligible, and the GHSA payloads accordingly print zero '8th' grades in any slice, while GIAA's '8th' readings are legitimate and are how these class years were derived. Every one of the fourteen is GIAA-only, checked season by season - none touches a GHSA bracket (25 Oct 2026).
